title: DeepCirc-interp: end-to-end interpretability companion code for the DeepCirc paper (Supplementary Figures S10–S15)
description: End-to-end interpretability pipeline for the DeepCirc paper (Palacios et al.), covering the cross-topology design-rule analyses and per-design attribution work behind supplementary figures S10–S15. Includes target Boolean function selection, topology population generation (via PPO+GAT, upstream DeepCirc), Stage-2 MLP training and design-space scoring, downstream L1/L2/L3 cross-topology analyses, single-topology slot-level Shapley + pairwise Shapley–Taylor epistasis on the three yellow-dot exemplars (0x2B / 0x17 / 0x6D), and the vector-first manifest-driven figure-assembly pipeline. The upstream training framework (sebastianrpalacios/DeepCirc) is vendored as a pinned git submodule.
notes: This deposit accompanies the DeepCirc paper (citation pending). The deposit's 'figures' tier (~10 MB) holds the small CSV/JSON intermediates needed to rebuild supplementary figures S10–S15 from the assembly scripts on a laptop. The 'full' tier (tens of GB) additionally holds trained Stage-2 MLP checkpoints, design-space predictions, per-exemplar HDF5 samples, and PPO+GAT agent registries needed for full end-to-end re-runs from population scoring onward.
